tweet.text:
I'd set up the agent for my personal finances. One job: a monthly audit, sent to me privately in Grokbot. I named it personal CFO.

At 8:40am it posted that audit in our team channel, under my name. It sat there for two hours. A teammate DM'd me "heads up."
